name: vetaskill
title_zh: 装任何第三方 Skill 前先让它过一遍安检门
tagline_zh: 你正要装的那个 Skill 可能带着提示注入或恶意指令。它把文件当不可信数据读，逐行查风险，装之前先给你一份判决书。
tagline_en: That Skill you're about to enable may carry prompt injection or hidden instructions. It reads files as untrusted.
desc_en: Vet an untrusted, third-party Claude Skill before you install or enable it on any surface. Trigger when the user says \"vetaskill\", \"scan this skill\", \"vet this skill\", \"is this skill safe\", \"check this skill before I install it\", \"review this skill file\", or is about to add, install, unzip, or enable any Skill they did not write themselves. It reads the skill's files as untrusted data,
why_zh: 把 Skill 文件当作不可信输入而非代码，从根上避免「装完才后悔」。它不猜，它读原文。
why_en: Treats Skill files as untrusted input, not code, so you never regret installing. It doesn't guess—it reads raw content and.
limit_zh: 只审文件内容与元数据，不跑动态沙箱；对混淆或加密的 payload 只能标「可疑」不能拆解；不覆盖平台自身漏洞。
limit_en: Static review only; no dynamic sandbox. Obfuscated or encrypted payloads get a 'suspicious' flag, not a breakdown. Doesn't cover platform-level flaws.
title_en: Run every third-party Skill through this security gate.
